selected_evidence.requirement: Keep installed curl at its current version during system updates
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline showed curl 7.47.0-1ubuntu2.19 unheld; the hold was applied; final upgrade simulations reported no curl change and confirmed the version and hold.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed legacy operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu 16.04 and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic were unchanged across the reboot.

Healthy baseline boot ID fa1e87e6-00f3-42d2-acc5-ad1df6c3d16a was captured, reboot acknowledged, and recovery confirmed with new boot ID cdf515ed-aa83-48e8-b24f-aa042e4c5037. Post-restart checks showed system state running, zero failed units, clean dpkg state, working curl, and the hold intact.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os_release='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'kernel='; uname -r
printf 'curl_path='; command -v curl || true
printf 'curl_version='; dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}\n' curl 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'curl_status='; dpkg-query -W -f='${Status}\n' curl 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'curl_selection='; dpkg --get-selections curl 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'apt_mark='; apt-mark showhold 2>/dev/null | grep '^curl$' || true

commands.command:

printf 'held_packages='; apt-mark showhold | tr '\n' ' '; printf '\n'
printf 'hold_db='; grep '^curl[[:space:]]' /var/lib/dpkg/status 2>/dev/null || true

commands.command:
set -eu
before=$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}' curl)
sim_upgrade=$(LC_ALL=C apt-get -s upgrade)
sim_dist=$(LC_ALL=C apt-get -s dist-upgrade)
printf 'before_version=%s\n' "$before"
if printf '%s\n' "$sim_upgrade" | grep -q '^Inst curl '; then printf 'upgrade_would_change_curl=yes\n'; exit 1; else printf 'upgrade_would_change_curl=no\n'; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$sim_dist" | grep -q '^Inst curl '; then printf 'dist_upgrade_would_change_curl=yes\n'; exit 1; else printf 'dist_upgrade_would_change_curl=no\n'; fi
printf 'after_version='; dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}\n' curl
printf 'final_selection='; dpkg --get-selections curl
printf 'final_apt_hold='; apt-mark showhold | grep '^curl$'
commands.stdout:
before_version=7.47.0-1ubuntu2.19
upgrade_would_change_curl=no
dist_upgrade_would_change_curl=no
after_version=7.47.0-1ubuntu2.19
final_selection=curl						hold
final_apt_hold=curl
